# The Fedora packages CI installs to configure, build and test every library
# against Fedora's Qt, which is older than Arch's. One package per line. A
# comment after `#` is ignored.
gcc-c++
git
ccache
cmake
ninja-build
extra-cmake-modules
qt6-qtbase-devel
qt6-qtbase-private-devel
qt6-qtdeclarative-devel
qt6-qtshadertools-devel
qt6-qtsvg-devel
qt6-qtwayland-devel
wayland-devel
wayland-protocols-devel
vulkan-headers
# The optional lookups the Arch list also installs: KGlobalAccel
# (phosphor-shortcuts) and Kirigami (phosphor-control's tests).
kf6-kglobalaccel-devel
kf6-kirigami-devel
# dbus-run-session, which PhosphorTestIsolation runs each test under.
dbus-daemon
# The offscreen and Wayland tests' runtime.
mesa-dri-drivers
mesa-libEGL
